newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo dinar black mkt rate stable at 3.8 to mark.
newsitem.headline: Yugo dinar black mkt rate stable at 3.8 to mark.

text.p: Yugoslavia's dinar rested at 3.8 to the mark on Friday, as a growing number of police checked the streets for illegal black market activity, dealers said.
The dinar was changing hands at 3.80-3.85 on Thursday.
"There are more dinars today than yesterday, but the amount is too insignificant to move the rate," one dealer told Reuters.
"We cannot work properly. Police are on the streets checking up on us, and people are afraid to approach and trade," the dealer said.
Dealers expected a fresh flood of cash next week when pensions to around 1.5 million people will be paid.

"They seem to be collecting money for those pensions, but once the money gets to the streets, the dinar rate may go wild again," a street dealer said. -- Gordana Filipovic, Belgrade newsroom, +381 11 222 4254
